title: The Wolf of Highmoor Revisited
author: Yara Hartwell
blurb: Theo Dunmore, the youngest member of a dying guild, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
